subject: general
question: In June 2022, Polyversity - India's largest educational metaverse with over 100 educational partners, was launched by Union Minister Shri Dharmendra Pradhan in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **June 2022**, **Polyversity**, India's largest educational metaverse with over 100 educational partners, was launched by **Union Minister Shri Dharmendra Pradhan** in the city of **New Delhi**.
 
• Polyversity **aims to provide a platform **for immersive learning experiences using the metaverse, offering students and educators opportunities for virtual classrooms, skill development, and enhanced educational engagement through technology.
 
• Polyversity has over **100 educational partners**, including universities, institutions, and ed-tech companies, who contribute resources and content for a wide array of courses, ranging from technical education to arts and humanities.
 
• Polyversity **also includes the creation of virtual campuses** that allow students to navigate through buildings, interact in virtual lecture halls, and participate in extracurricular activities—all within a digital environment.
